newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Armed attacker takes Swiss bank employees hostage.
newsitem.headline: Armed attacker takes Swiss bank employees hostage.

text.p: An armed man entered a bank in the Swiss city of Lucerne on Wednesday, took two bank employees hostage and wounded another, Swiss police said.
Shots were fired inside the building of Bank Regio during the early morning attack, a police spokesman in Lucerne said. The hostage-taker was demanding one million Swiss francs ($700,000) in ransom.
Police said the hostage-taker, who spoke broken German, was still inside the bank.
Security forces cordoned off the bank building and positioned snipers on neighbouring rooftops, police said.
No other details were immediately available.
